This morning, a few tips for passengers
It concerns the desk
Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so our team can review each pet's travel plan and help avoid last-minute trouble. We are sorry for any mix-ups, and we want everyone to have a calmer trip.

<<FACT F068>> Staff also note changes in the desk ledger, because small details can matter a lot when a pet is traveling. The team looks at species, temperament, and comfort when setting up care, and that helps us keep the process steady and kind.

<<FACT F079>> Please bring any needed papers with you and let the desk know about special feeding, handling, or resting needs ahead of time.

For quick help and the latest guidance, please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
